### The Fall of Jeroboam I and Rehoboam
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/fall-of-jeroboam-and-rehoboam
Passage: 1 Kings 14:22-24
Points:
- Rehoboam failed to maintain loyalty to the Lord, leading Judah into grave apostasy.
- The southern kingdom provoked God to jealousy by establishing pagan shrines and engaging in cult prostitution.
- God sent Egypt against Jerusalem as divine discipline for the nation's spiritual betrayal.
- Despite the failure of David's royal heirs, God preserved the Davidic line out of sheer grace.
- The ongoing endurance of God's people relies completely on His grace rather than human merit.

### Bible Pathway - Apr. 27, 2010
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-apr-27-2010-11629431.html
Passage: 1 Kings 14:22-27
Points:
- After initially following the Lord, Rehoboam abandoned God's law once his rule became established.
- Judah indulged in idolatrous shrines and abominations that provoked God to withdraw His protection.
- Egypt plundered the golden treasures of the temple as a consequence of Judah's unfaithfulness.
- Rehoboam substituted bronze shields for the stolen golden ones, keeping up outward appearances.
- Religious ritual and appearances are worthless before God without genuine obedience from the heart.
